description.p: VetroLog is a high-performance desktop SQLite database inspector designed for mobile developers building applications with Flutter, Android, and React Native.

ul.li: Zero mobile SDK setup required: inspect any debuggable mobile app database via ADB
Instant real-time synchronization on SQLite WAL (Write-Ahead Logging) database files
Intelligent SQL Playground with multi-tab workspace and syntax highlighting
Visual EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN execution tree to identify full-table scans
AI-powered natural language SQL generator using Gemini 2.5 Flash
One-click Index Advisor for automatic index creation recommendations
In-place DataGrid table editing with live write-back to device

description.p: Release v1.3.0 brings in-app background auto-updates, 5-second countdown restart, atomic ADB caching, and the official documentation site.
